2.title: 🏠 Home
2.description: Home screen (excluding the queue itself): activity/streak widget, nag banners (notifications/subscription), collection-group provenance, featured starter packs, opening the player. Child suite: Playlist.

19.title: ▶️ Playlist
19.description: Up-next queue: order, swipe-to-archive, completion badge persistence, collection-group rendering, resume at saved position.

3.title: 🔍 Search
3.description: Search input and debounce, verse-reference search, pagination/infinite scroll, empty state, content-language scoping. Child suites: Filters, Tracks.

20.title: 🎚️ Filters
20.description: Search filters: authors, sources, locations, languages, tags, topics, date range, duration, sort; active-filter badge, reset, immediate re-query.

21.title: 🎵 Tracks
21.description: Track row states (none/added/downloading/failed/completed) on discovery surfaces, add/remove, failed-download retry on tap, bulk add.

4.title: 📚 Library
4.description: Library landing page, scripture/verse search, content-language scoping, original-script text / prose / recitation display. Child suites: Collections, Topics, Smart Library.

5.title: ✨ Smart Library
5.description: Smart Library (Pro): banner with PRO badge and gating, settings dialog (duration target, auto-archive, filters), background auto-download/auto-archive, sync with Settings.

12.title: 🗂 Collections
12.description: Opening a collection, collection groups, adding a single track / multiple / the whole collection, language-scoped contents, provenance grouping on Home.

13.title: #️⃣ Topics
13.description: Opening a topic from grid/shelf, topic detail page and covers, adding tracks, language-scoped contents, empty state.

6.title: 🎧 Player
6.description: Floating mini-player (pulse until tapped), full player, play/pause, skip ±15s, seek, playback speed, auto-play next (Pro). Child suites: Transcript, Notes, Sharing, Mixer.

7.title: 📝 Transcript
7.description: Transcript view synced to audio, text selection via touch-drag + popover, outline/chapters, citations, transcript language switch, loading/error/empty states.

8.title: 🔖 Notes
8.description: Notes/bookmarks: create from transcript selection, notes list, search with highlight, delete (from list and from transcript), share text/audio, empty state.

9.title: 📤 Sharing
9.description: Sharing: audio excerpt (cut by timecodes, background job >3s), transcript PDF (CDN cache), native share sheet. PDF is offered for any track that has a transcript, regardless of language. Covers audio / transcript / PDF share types.

22.title: 🎚️ Mixer
22.description: Stereo mixer (L↔R blend): puck drag, center deadzone snap-back, engagement boundary, haptic ticks, persistence across tracks, no-op on mono audio.

10.title: ⬇️ Downloads
10.description: Download a track, progress, state persistence, retry after failure, interrupted-download recovery, CDN rotation, concurrent-download dedup. Child suite: Offline playback.

23.title: 📴 Offline playback
23.description: Playing a downloaded track with no network: local file:// playback, state hydrated after restart, transcript available offline.

11.title: 💬 Chat
11.description: AI chat: send a question, "Thinking…" streaming, answer rendering, follow-ups, question types (factual/philosophical/find-verse/make-PDF/locate-story), service-unavailable UX. Child suites: Answer cards, Session history, Rate limits.

24.title: 🃏 Answer cards
24.description: Chip→card upgrade for verse/citation/chapter payloads, verse recitation audio, citation in-line player, share-PDF action card, broken-payload fallback.

25.title: 🕘 Session history
25.description: Chat history sheet: list prior sessions, search, open a session, new session, delete one / delete all.

26.title: 🚦 Rate limits
26.description: Free vs Pro daily quota, usage chip visibility threshold, quota-exhausted composer lock + upgrade CTA, UTC-midnight reset, rate-limit backend unavailable.

14.title: 💳 Subscription
14.description: Paywall: feature carousel, plans and free-trial badge (14 days), purchase, restore, manage subscription, RU "Can't pay" support email, legal links.

15.title: 👤 Account
15.description: Account profile, subscription/tier display and sync, account deletion (with/without local wipe), Pro expiry. Child suite: Authentication.

27.title: 🔐 Authentication
27.description: Sign-in (Google), sign-out, anonymous vs authenticated, token refresh, what requires an account.

16.title: ⚙️ Settings
16.description: Settings: app language (single), library languages (multi-select dialog), appearance toggles, Pro toggles (auto-next/auto-scroll), chat settings, sadhana/reminders, DB export/import, debug section, build info.

17.title: ❓ Help
17.description: In-app help: opening HelpDialog, TOC and page navigation, multilingual content (en/ru).

18.title: 📱 Platform-specific
18.description: Device-dependent behaviors (run once per device): background audio, lock-screen/notification media controls, audio focus/interruptions, native file:// playback, WorkManager/MIUI downloads, notification permission (Android 13+), IAP store differences + RU no-IAP, share sheet, haptics, keyboard, deep links, system bars.

35.title: 🚀 Onboarding
35.description: First-launch onboarding: the value carousel (welcome → interest topics → daily-wisdom toggle → value moment → soft paywall), the skip gate (new user vs. established user with listening history), and persistence of the completed flag.
